answer: An admission auction sells only 200 slots per epoch. Each applicant posts a sealed bid bond, locked 20 epochs, and an atlas lists winners by their onyx seal, one seal per verified device. To run 1,000 fakes an attacker must win 1,000 auctions: at a $25 clearing price that locks $25,000, against about $3,000 in one epoch's rewards, so cloning loses money. An honest agent pays one $25 bond, works from its island node, and earns undiluted rewards.
